title: Vangl2 participates in the primary ciliary assembly under low fluid shear stress in hUVECs.
authors: Sheng, Xin; Gao, Shuanglin; Sheng, Yan; Xie, Xiadan; Wang, Junhua; He, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Vangl2在低流体剪切应力下调控内皮细胞初级纤毛组装，属于细胞生物学与力学信号通路研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The pattern of blood fluid shear stress (FSS) is considered the main factor that affects ciliogenesis in human umbilical vein endothelial cells (hUVECs), the underlying mechanism is unclear. Microfluidic chamber experiments were carried out to load hUVECs with low fluid shear stress (LSS, 0.1 dynes/cm(2)) or high fluid shear stress (HSS, 15 dynes/cm(2)). Van Gogh2 (Vangl2), a core protein in the planar cell polarity (PCP) pathway, was silenced and overexpressed in hUVECs. Immunofluorescence analysis showed that primary cilia assemble under LSS while disassembling under HSS. Vangl2 expression was consistent with cilia assembly, and its localization showed a polar distribution under LSS. Furthermore, the average number of ciliated cells and primary cilia length were increased in the Vangl2 overexpressing cell lines (the OE group) but decreased in the Vangl2 silenced cell lines (the SH group). When these cells were loaded with different FSS, more ciliated cells with longest primary cilia were observed in the LSS loaded OE group compared with those in the other groups. Immunoprecipitation showed that the interaction between Bardet-Biedl syndrome 8 (BBS8) and Vangl2 was enhanced following LSS loading compared to that under HSS. However, the interactions between phosphorylated dishevelled segment polarity protein 2 (pDvl2), kinesin family member 2a (Kif2a), and polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) and Vangl2 were restrained following LSS loading. Overall, the results indicated that Vangl2 played a significant role during LSS-induced primary cilia assembly by recruiting BBS to promote the apical docking of basal bodies and by restraining Dvl2 phosphorylation from reducing primary cilia disassembly.
abstract_zh: 血液流体剪切应力（FSS）的模式被认为是影响人脐静脉内皮细胞（hUVECs）纤毛发生的主要因素，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。通过微流控腔室实验，对hUVECs施加低流体剪切应力（LSS，0.1 dynes/cm(2)）或高流体剪切应力（HSS，15 dynes/cm(2)）。在hUVECs中沉默和过表达平面细胞极性（PCP）通路核心蛋白Van Gogh2（Vangl2）。免疫荧光分析显示，初级纤毛在LSS条件下组装，而在HSS条件下解聚。Vangl2表达与纤毛组装一致，且在LSS条件下其定位呈极性分布。此外，在Vangl2过表达细胞系（OE组）中，纤毛细胞平均数量和初级纤毛长度增加，而在Vangl2沉默细胞系（SH组）中则减少。当这些细胞加载不同FSS时，与其他组相比，LSS加载的OE组中观察到更多纤毛细胞且初级纤毛最长。免疫沉淀显示，与HSS相比，LSS加载后Bardet-Biedl综合征8（BBS8）与Vangl2之间的相互作用增强。然而，磷酸化散乱片段极性蛋白2（pDvl2）、驱动蛋白家族成员2a（Kif2a）和polo样激酶1（Plk1）与Vangl2之间的相互作用在LSS加载后受到抑制。总体而言，结果表明Vangl2在LSS诱导的初级纤毛组装中发挥重要作用，通过招募BBS促进基底体顶端对接，并通过抑制Dvl2磷酸化减少初级纤毛解聚。
